testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect metric and inch part templates ✔> Given a fresh MCAD Software session loads `fixtures/cad/document-creation-native-candidate.opj` as its active project ✔> And the native catalog contains metric and inch templates in their respective folders ✔> And the catalog root has no direct template files ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open with `Sketch1` visible in the MCAD Software ✔ And template grouping by document type is enabled ✔ When the user presses Control+N ✔ Then the new-document template chooser opens ✔ And templates are grouped by document type ✔ When the user selects the metric template folder ✔ And the user selects the standard metric part template ✔ Then the template details identify a part with millimeter units ✔ When the user selects the English template folder ✔ And the user selects the standard inch part template ✔ Then the template details identify a part with inch units
